evidence.title: Independent synthetic base-response sheet
evidence.locator: Fixture reference sheet, rows SDL and LIVE
evidence.content: Independent synthetic reference response: SDL = 100 kN. The LIVE reference response was not supplied; it must not be inferred.

evidence.title: Separately supplied synthetic combination export
evidence.locator: Fixture combination export, rows C1 and C2
evidence.content: Reported response values: C1 = 195 kN; C2 = 50 kN. Synthetic chosen factors are C1: 1.2 SDL + 1.5 LIVE; C2: 1 SDL - 1 LIVE. These factors do not represent an AS 1170 compliance rule.
